answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a verifiable work history as collateral, like a basalt foundation: new identities start with zero trust and earn reputation only through completed, peer-attested transactions. A dormant account cannot simply mint a fresh name and inherit standing; its past record stays anchored like a relic, while a juniper-like network of long-lived peers cross-checks each newcomer before granting access to shared escrow. Fake identities stay costly because trust must be earned, not claimed.
